next_step.title: The page-claimed sweep: Imperial Valley, Sierra and Golden West's extraction
next_step.text: A page that heads a section per award now serves each sibling program. Foothill gained 28 programs and Golden West's capture 14; run each college with many page-claimed programs through a free capture, then extract. Palomar needs its own reader look.

calls.title: The second reader waits on a new xAI subscription
calls.text: Sam, 2026-10-20 about 16:30 UTC: the API is paid for separately from the Grok subscription, and the account is moving to the RCCD district credit card. When the key exists: Sam sets XAI_API_KEY and XAI_MODEL as Edge Function secrets on the Work Plan project, a session deploys program-requirements-extract with cpl-chat-deploy.yml, then runs second-reader.yml for Canada College.
calls.no_reply: The second reader stays built and unrun; the records that fail a machine check are read by one model and Jev's sittings, whose verdicts files carry each college's next fix.

answer.words: Later, on Open Asks Sheet 98 card 2: "I need to get a new subscription first which will take a few days, so keep this on ice for now."

notes.addenda: The eight addenda amending loaded colleges' catalogs were read on Oct 14 and filed on Oct 14 as read, each with the programs and courses it changes. The other 71 listed addenda wait for the reader to reach their colleges.

changes.text: A catalog page that heads a section for each award, such as Foothill's A.A. and certificate on one page, now serves each sibling program.
Foothill re-read and loaded: 144 programs found, up from 116; 97 pass the machine checks, up from 73; 29 new records.
The Records view no longer remembers picked colleges or filters between visits.
Six thin colleges captured again for free; Reedley's reader now finds 196 of its 200 programs with a closed course list, and the five CourseLeaf colleges found the same pages as before.
Reedley extracted for 11 dollars 18, 167 of 196 passing the machine checks, and 159 new records loaded.
Reedley's display build written and its display job started.
